program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in":  (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # OTA diff pair gm/Id (PMOS)
    "L_in":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # OTA diff pair L
    "itail":    (30e-6, 10e-6, 40e-6),  # OTA tail current
    "gmid_p":   (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # pass device gm/Id at max load
    "L_p":      (0.36, 0.18, 0.6),      # pass / diode L
    "N":        (20.0, 8.0, 50.0),      # pass : gate-diode mirror ratio
    "rs":       (1000.0, 300.0, 3000.0),# driver source degeneration
    "ugf_min":  (6e5, 2e5, 1.5e6),      # target loop UGF at min load
    "fz_ratio": (0.25, 0.1, 0.6),       # Rz-Cc zero placed at fz_ratio*ugf_min
    "idiv":     (5e-6, 2e-6, 20e-6),    # feedback divider current
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = 1.8
    vref = spec.get("vref", 0.6); vo = spec.get("vout_target", 1.2)
    imax = spec.get("iload_max", 5e-3); imin = spec.get("iload_min", 50e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-9)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    beta = vref / vo

    # ---- feedback divider ----
    idiv = p["idiv"]; rtot = vo / idiv
    r2 = rtot * beta; r1 = rtot - r2

    # ---- pass device + gate diode (1:N current mirror; gate tracks vin) ----
    N = p["N"]; Lp = p["L_p"]
    ipmax = imax + idiv; ipmin = imin + idiv
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], Lp, ipmax, vds=vin - vo)
    mdio = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], Lp, ipmax / N, vds=mp.vgs)
    idmax = ipmax / N; idmin = ipmin / N
    vg_max = vin - mp.vgs                     # lowest gate voltage (max load)

    # ---- degenerated NMOS driver ----
    rs = p["rs"]; Ld = 0.5
    vrs = idmax * rs
    mdrv = lut.size("n", 8.0, Ld, idmax, vds=max(vg_max - vrs, 0.15))

    def find_vgs(dev, W, L, I, vds):
        lo, hi = 0.0, 1.8
        for _ in range(48):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            if lut.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds)["Id"] > I:
                hi = mid
            else:
                lo = mid
        return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

    vgs_dmin = find_vgs("n", mdrv.W, Ld, idmin, 0.6)
    od = lut.op("n", mdrv.W, Ld, vgs_dmin, 0.6)
    gm_dmin = od["gm"]
    Gm_min = gm_dmin / (1 + gm_dmin * rs)
    Gm_max = mdrv.gm / (1 + mdrv.gm * rs)

    # ---- OTA: PMOS pair (wells tied to source), NMOS mirror load ----
    ihalf = p["itail"] / 2
    m1 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], ihalf, vds=0.6)
    m3 = lut.size("n", 10.0, 1.0, ihalf, vds=0.6)
    m3 = lut.size("n", 10.0, 1.0, ihalf, vds=m3.vgs)
    vs_tail = vref + m1.vgs
    mt = lut.size("p", 12.0, 1.0, p["itail"], vds=max(vin - vs_tail, 0.2))

    # ---- bias chain from IREF ----
    ib = 5e-6
    mb0 = lut.size("n", 12.0, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)
    mb0 = lut.size("n", 12.0, 1.0, iref, vds=mb0.vgs)
    mb1 = lut.size("n", 12.0, 1.0, ib, vds=mb0.vgs)
    mb2 = lut.size("p", 12.0, 1.0, ib, vds=0.6)
    mb2 = lut.size("p", 12.0, 1.0, ib, vds=mb2.vgs)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    Ro = 1.0 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A1 = gm1 * Ro

    # ---- compensation: mid-band OTA gain gm1*Rz sets UGF at min load ----
    ugf_min = p["ugf_min"]
    A1mid = 2 * PI * cl * ugf_min / (beta * N * Gm_min)
    rz = min(A1mid / gm1, 0.3 * Ro)
    fz = p["fz_ratio"] * ugf_min
    cc = 1.0 / (2 * PI * rz * fz)
    ugf_max = ugf_min * Gm_max / Gm_min

    # ---- netlist ----
    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MB1", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb1)
    n.dev("MB2", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", mb2)
    n.dev("MT", "st", "pb", "vin", "vin", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vref", "st", "st", m1)     # diode side: non-inverting (vref)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "fb", "st", "st", m1)        # output side: inverting (fb)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vss", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "d1", "vss", "vss", m3)
    n.R("RZ", "x", "xc", rz)
    n.C("CC", "xc", "vss", cc)
    n.dev("MD", "g", "x", "sd", "vss", mdrv)
    n.R("RS", "sd", "vss", rs)
    n.dev("MDIO", "g", "g", "vin", "vin", mdio)
    mf = int(min(200, max(1, math.ceil(mp.W / 40.0))))
    n.dev("MP", "vout", "g", "vin", "vin", mp, m=mf)
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", r1)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", r2)

    # ---- predictions ----
    vsg_pmin = find_vgs("p", mp.W, Lp, ipmin, vin - vo)
    opmin = lut.op("p", mp.W, Lp, vsg_pmin, vin - vo)
    gdsp_min = opmin["gds"]
    Rout_min = 1.0 / (gdsp_min + 1.0 / rtot)
    Rout_max = 1.0 / (mp.gds + 1.0 / rtot)

    def psrr(f, Gm, Rout, gdsp):
        s = 2j * PI * f
        Zx = 1.0 / (1.0 / Ro + 1.0 / (rz + 1.0 / (s * cc)))
        Zout = 1.0 / (1.0 / Rout + s * cl)
        T = beta * gm1 * Zx * N * Gm * Zout
        return db(abs(1 + T) / abs(gdsp * Zout))

    psrr_1k = min(psrr(1e3, Gm_min, Rout_min, gdsp_min),
                  psrr(1e3, Gm_max, Rout_max, mp.gds))

    x_bal = m3.vgs
    x_min = vgs_dmin + idmin * rs
    x_max = mdrv.vgs + idmax * rs
    err_v = max(abs(x_min - x_bal), abs(x_max - x_bal)) / (A1 * beta)
    vout_err_pct = 100 * err_v / vo
    load_reg = abs(x_max - x_min) / (A1 * beta) / (imax - imin)

    iq = iref + ib + p["itail"] + idiv + idmin
    undershoot = (imax - imin) / (cl * 2 * PI * math.sqrt(ugf_min * ugf_max)) + 0.02
    T0_max = beta * A1 * N * Gm_max * Rout_max
    line_reg = 1.0 / max(T0_max, 1.0)

    return n, {
        "vout_err_pct": vout_err_pct,
        "load_reg": load_reg,
        "line_reg": line_reg,
        "psrr_1k": psrr_1k,
        "iq": iq,
        "undershoot": undershoot,
        "overshoot": undershoot,
        "ripple_settled": 0.002,
    }
